thread:
jordan: FYI i'm opening a preflight thread for the 1.4.3-private packaging and delivery to VPC customers in APAC/EMEA. Build window 07:30 UTC tomorrow, canary starts 09:00 UTC.
lina: thanks. scope? installer + runtime image + shrinkwrap manifest?
jordan: yes. shrinkwrap + installer + runtime image pins. No DB migration.
harry: pin policy: installer tag `v1.4.3-private-rc2`, runtime pinned to digest, submanifest published to signer-store and mirrored to offline buckets.
lina: who will own the mirror push?
sasha: ops will push to mirrors (me). i'll need the signed submanifest and the transport manifest by 08:10 UTC.
jordan: signing owner: lina will sign. please use ephemeral key with a 6h TTL. ops-bot: noted and added to runbook.
ops-bot: runbook entry created: sign-owner=lina, mirror-owner=sasha, preflight-standup=08:20 UTC #release-ops
devbot: [info] packaging started: `./scripts/build-airgap --version v1.4.3-private-rc2`
devbot: [info] created artifact: redwood-private-installer-1.4.3-rc2.tar.gz (1.1GB)
devbot: [info] computing checksums and building submanifest
lina: cosign: signing now. will publish signature to signer-store once complete.
devbot: [info] cosign: queued
lina: cosign: done. signature=cosign:sha256:deadbeef... uploaded to signer-store under key lina@redwood/ephemeral-2026-01-13
sasha: mirrors: i'll need a copy of the signed submanifest and the packaged tarball. sftp creds?
jordan: use the staging-transport account. i'll add sasha to the transport ACL. ops-bot: added sasha to staging-transport ACL.
harry: monitoring and rollback hooks: primary: error-rate >2% for 10m, secondary: KV cache mismatch alert, tertiary: 429 surge >3% 5m. If triggered, abort and pin-back to v1.4.2-private.
lina: please include an explicit abort command block in runbook. ops-bot: appended abort commands.
ops-bot: abort snippet added:
```
# abort and pin-back
deploy-bot abort --thread 1765566000 --reason "canary fail"
deploy-bot pin --manifest submanifest-1.4.2-private.json --force
```
jordan: preflight checklist (short):
- verify artifact sha256 matches submanifest
- cosign signature present in signer-store
- signed submanifest uploaded to mirrors
- transport ACLs set for sftp
- monitoring dashboards enabled for canary hosts
- customer comms drafted (CS + sales)

harry: quick health probes: enable kv-checker on canary hosts and set synthetic traffic at 5rps for 15m after seed. report latency and error.
lina: signed submanifest uploaded to signer-store and scp'd to mirror staging at 08:12 UTC.
sasha: mirror push complete: mirrors:apac-1, mirrors:emea-1. Verified checksums.
devbot: [scheduled] canary rollout: 2026-01-13T09:00:00Z thread=1765566000 initiator=jordan
jordan: communication: i'll post the release note stub to #product-release at 08:30 UTC and ping CS + sales. Also will send a short opt-in invite to EMEA beta customers for the early canary.
sasha: one more: offline airgap carriers need the transport manifest with the cosign sig attached. i placed that in sftp:/staging/airgap-1.4.3/transport-manifest.json.sig
jordan: final: if cosign key expires mid-run, lina will re-sign and ops will re-push; use ephemeral key rotation procedure in runbook. Thanks all, i'll kick at 07:30 UTC and update this thread once artifacts are green. :white_check_mark:
